name: cli-templates
body: CLI templates command: `kalide templates [name]` lists the project's templates or shows one template by name. The no-name form prints one line per template with its description; the named form prints the template's fields (type, required, default, limits, formats, description), its child sections — for a slide template the sections it declares, for a section template the sections it can hold — each with the section templates it accepts and its min/max repeats, its body rules and its example, under usage-dependent headings (slide: `Sections:`/declares; section: `Child sections:`/Can hold). Owns internal/cli/templates.go — the command handler `runTemplates` and its printers (`printTemplateList`, `printTemplateDetails`, `printTemplateFields`, `printTemplateSections`, `printTemplateBody`, `printTemplateExample` and helpers) — the CLI presentation half of domain.service.template-registry. The remaining CLI commands (init, init-library, start, version) stay on solution.component.cli-commands.
